subject: HIPAA BAA eligibility and deployment options ' follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@healthcloud.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@healthcloud.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up and next steps from today's HIPAA discovery call

Hi Sarah / Tom '

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we can converge on eligibility and procurement items: 

1) What we heard from you:
- You need to understand whether Redwood can execute a BAA and what deployment modes are eligible for PHI-handling.
- You want SOC 2 evidence, our approach to PHI boundaries, and an initial security questionnaire so your InfoSec team can start their review.

2) From Redwood: short answers up front (details / artifacts attached) '
- SOC 2: We currently hold SOC 2 Type I (in-scope: production systems). Type II is in progress; expected report availability: Q3 2026. See attached "redwood_soc2_summary.pdf" for scope and timeline.
- BAA: We offer a BAA for customers that will process PHI ' available for Dedicated and Private deployments. For hosted API (shared multitenant), PHI is not supported except in narrow, contractually agreed cases (please see attachment and matrix).
- Eligible deployment modes for PHI: Private (VPC or on-prem) and Dedicated (reserved GPU pools with contractual controls). Hosted (public API) is not eligible for PHI by default.
- PHI boundaries: Redwood does not persist prompt/response content beyond ephemeral cache unless you opt-in; for PHI workloads we recommend disabling logging, enabling customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM), and using our Private deployment or Dedicated with strict isolation. More detail in the deployment matrix attachment.

3) Proposed next steps / asks for you:
- Please share the initial security questionnaire (we'll start filling it out). If you prefer, we can start with the standard questionnaire template I attached or you can send yours.
- Please confirm whether you expect to send/receive PHI in the hosted API during evaluation. If yes, we need to pause and move directly to a Dedicated/Private evaluation.
- Can we schedule a brief follow-up (30 min) with Rishi (security), Dev (SE) and your InfoSec to walk through the questionnaire and deployment options?

I've attached: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf and a redwood_deployment_matrix.xlsx that maps capabilities to PHI eligibility. Looping in Rishi (security) and Dev (SE). 

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, redwood_deployment_matrix.xlsx

From: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@healthcloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@healthcloud.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up and next steps from today's HIPAA discovery call

Thanks Marissa ' very helpful recap. A few quick clarifying Qs from our InfoSec / Compliance triage: 

1) Can you confirm whether Redwood currently accepts responsibility for PHI processing in Hosted API under any contractual terms, or is that only through Dedicated/Private?
2) We'd like the SOC 2 Type II ETA in writing for our procurement timeline (we're aiming to close the security review by end of Q3).
3) I've attached our initial security questionnaire (security_questionnaire_HC.docx) ' can you confirm who will own completion and what timeline you expect?

We are leaning toward Dedicated for an initial pilot given our timelines, but need the BAA and questionnaire answers to proceed. If you can get us a BAA draft, that would accelerate legal review.

Thanks ' I'll wait for the questionnaire ownership before setting a formal InfoSec call.

'Sarah
Sarah Miller
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance | HealthCloud Inc
sarah.miller@healthcloud.com

Attachment: security_questionnaire_HC.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@healthcloud.com>, Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@healthcloud.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up and next steps from today's HIPAA discovery call

Hi Sarah '

Great, thanks for the questions. Answers inline below and next steps: 

1) Hosted API & PHI: By default, our hosted multitenant API is not authorized for PHI. We can discuss a narrow, contractual exception in some enterprise cases, but the standard path for PHI is Dedicated or Private deployments. We'll flag that in the BAA draft.

2) SOC 2 Type II: Confirmed '
 Type II run is underway; expected final report delivery: mid-August 2026 (we'll provide an ETA letter for procurement teams).

3) Questionnaire: Rishi will lead completion from security side; Dev will handle architecture and deployment answers. Rishi ' can you take the HC questionnaire and target a first-pass in 5 business days?

4) BAA draft: I'm attaching a BAA draft for review (hipaa_baa_draft_20260530.docx). It reflects standard terms for Dedicated/Private deployments with PHI processing clauses and options for customer-managed KMS. Legal is ready to iterate.

5) PHI boundaries / recommended config: short checklist '
- Use Dedicated or Private deployment.
- Enable customer-managed keys for data at rest.
- Disable persistent logs for prompt/response or ship logs to customer-owned S3 with limited retention.
- Enforce VPC peering / private connectivity for Private deployment.

Next steps I'll take now: Rishi will start the questionnaire, legal will share BAA draft (attached), and we'll propose times for a 30-min InfoSec session next week.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments: hipaa_baa_draft_20260530.docx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@healthcloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up and next steps from today's HIPAA discovery call

Hi Sarah / Tom '

I picked up the questionnaire (security_questionnaire_HC.docx). Plan:
- First pass: architectural, controls, and policy answers (5 business days).
- Second pass: technical evidence and attachments (SOC 2 summary, logs retention options, KMS/HSM config examples).

A few quick items where I need your confirmation to provide precise answers: 
A) Pilot scope ' will the pilot include any ePHI uploads (file storage) or only conversational/text data? This changes our recommended approach.
B) Required retention for Audit logs ' do you have a minimum retention requirement? We can support customer-managed retention via Dedicated/Private.

I've attached a working copy of the questionnaire with a couple of initial answers and the redwood_deployment_matrix.xlsx. I'll target a first-pass back to you by EOD Friday, June 4.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@healthcloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@healthcloud.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 10:18:00 -0400

Thanks all ' that timeline works. Quick clarifications: 
- Pilot scope: conversational/text data only; no document uploads or file storage for the initial pilot.
- Audit log retention: procurement asks for 1 year minimum; for the pilot we can accept a shorter retention if we get an operational plan for 1 year in Dedicated/Private.

Please go ahead with the questionnaire answers and we'll plan the InfoSec call for next week. Also ' legal would like to review the BAA draft; Sarah.T.Legal@healthcloud.com will be on the loop once we send the DocuSign.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

'Sarah
